home.title: DesignForge
home.subtitle: A local-first Figma-like design workbench.
home.stage: Stage: {stage} — engineering foundation in place; pages land per FE-01 onward.
design.title: Design system preview
design.subtitle: Internal tool (not a reference page): dual-baseline tokens + base components across all states, for human review and component-level screenshot gates.
design.theme.label: Baseline
design.modal.title: Delete 3 layers
design.modal.desc: Deleted layers stay in trash for 30 days.
design.drawer.title: AI assistant (drawer sample)
design.state.empty.title: No files yet
design.state.empty.desc: Start from a template or create a blank design file.
design.state.error.title: Cannot reach the local service
design.state.error.desc: Make sure the daemon is running, then retry.
design.toast.failed: Export failed: not enough disk space
design.field.name: Layer name
design.tip: hover / active are reproduced with state-forcing classes (dfg-state-hover / dfg-state-active); focus-visible is captured by the screenshot gate with a real focus.
design.token.controlHeight: Control height md follows theme density: 32 light vs 28 dark
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Local-first: configuration and credentials stay on this machine (the local service data root).
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.loadError.title: Cannot reach the local service
settings.loadError.description: Settings are read and written by the local service (daemon). Start it, then reload.
settings.section.workspace.desc: Where documents and exported artifacts live.
settings.section.ai.desc: API key for text AI: stored encrypted locally, shown only as a mask.
settings.section.comfy.desc: Local image service endpoint; not running does not affect editing or text AI.
settings.section.telemetry.desc: Usage data stays local by default; when off, events are acknowledged without being written.
settings.field.workspaceDir.hint: ~ is expanded; writability is verified by the local service on save.
settings.error.apiKeyShape: Invalid key shape (expects the sk- prefix and a long token)
settings.field.apiKey.placeholder: sk-… (only a mask is shown after saving)
settings.field.apiKey.hint: The key is never echoed back; enter a new value to replace it.
settings.credential.missing: No key yet: AI runs degraded (local template fallback; editing and image generation still work).
settings.field.comfyUrl.hint: Image generation stays local: images and prompts never leave the machine.
settings.comfy.unprobed: Not probed yet: click "Probe again" to check the local service.
settings.telemetry.label: Data toggle
settings.telemetry.hint: When on, events are written only to the local data directory, never uploaded.
settings.dataDir.label: Data directory
settings.dataDir.hint: Credentials, config, telemetry and exports live here; opening a file manager needs the desktop app.
settings.dataDir.copyFailed: Copy failed; please select and copy the path manually.
onboarding.title: Four-step onboarding
onboarding.subtitle: Set up local capabilities: working directory → AI → image generation → telemetry; every step can be skipped.
onboarding.done.title: Onboarding complete
onboarding.done.desc: Configuration is saved to the local service. Next: create your first file.
coldstart.title: Welcome to DesignForge
coldstart.subtitle: A local-first Figma-like design workbench: your documents live on your own machine.
coldstart.empty.title: No files yet
coldstart.empty.desc: Create a sample file to look around the editor; you can delete it anytime.
coldstart.exists.title: {count} files already here
coldstart.exists.desc: Cold start is not needed anymore; head to the home page and continue.
coldstart.unreachable.title: Cannot reach the local service
coldstart.unreachable.desc: The sample file is created by the local service. Start the daemon, then retry.
